assumptions.statement: The overall and three key-area polygons are provisional rough substitutes derived from public wording and announced approximate areas; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All calculated areas and ratios are review-stage values and must be recalculated when official CAD/GIS boundaries arrive.
assumptions.resolution: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson with qualified official material, then rerun validation.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities and engineering constraints are unavailable in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal establishes spatial logic and projects but does not claim statutory development intensity.
assumptions.resolution: Professional teams must import and verify the password-protected qualification attachments.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual envelopes for project testing rather than a surveyed existing-building inventory.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain strategy-level and cannot authorize demolition.
assumptions.resolution: Complete heritage, structure, ownership and occupancy surveys before project approval.

assumptions.statement: Rail heritage elements shown in the concept cover and proposal are narrative prompts, not an inventory of protected assets.
assumptions.impact: Each intervention requires heritage grading and conservation consultation.
assumptions.resolution: Link an approved heritage register to project cards before detailed design.

assumptions.statement: Phasing assumes a public-interest governance platform and staged pilots; funding and institutional commitments are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Dates are readiness sequences, not government implementation promises.
assumptions.resolution: Convert phases into an approved action plan after departmental and community consultation.
